raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## What

Adds an XPU dispatch branch in `RMSNormGated.forward_xpu` that routes decode-shape calls to the fused `rms_norm_gated_decode` kernel (vllm-xpu-kernels side companion PR) instead of the generic Triton `rmsnorm_fn` path.

Gate: fp16, `x.shape` in ((16,128), (24,128)) (heads x head_v_dim), contiguous, `z` present with matching shape/dtype/device, `weight (128,)`, `bias is None`, `group_size is None`, `norm_before_gate=True`, activation silu/swish. Everything else falls through to the existing path unchanged.

## Scope

Model: Qwen3.5/3.6-A3B (Gated DeltaNet linear attention). XPU-only dispatch path; no changes to CUDA/native code paths.

## Validation

Tested on Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, per-tensor fp8 on-the-fly quantization, 2x Intel Arc Pro B70 (Xe2) TP2, eager, chunked prefill: outputs byte-identical with the fast path enabled vs. the existing path; no regressions observed across a range of concurrent request batch sizes.

Companion PR: vllm-xpu-kernels (kernel side).

What kind of benefit using this kernel? seems it's not a good idea to adopt under such a strict check and it may break xpu graph.

The kernel is in [#608](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-xpu-kernels/pull/608 )
This is to replace native ops to the sycltla fused kernel when torch compile is not activated.
The e2e time (including host) of kernel in decode side for Qwen35BA3B drop from 200+us to 9us.  This benefit is coming from submit overhead reduction.
Even compile is on,  the kernel is triton kernel. The E2E drop still from 50us to 9us, since triton kernel submit overhead is higher.
The E2E TPOT will drop about ~5ms in TP2.   @xiangyuT has more details about this kernel's benefit.

detail.title: Enable gated RMSNorm decode fast path for Qwen3.5/3.6-A3B on XPU

files.patch:
@@ -331,6 +331,29 @@ def forward_cuda(
     def forward_xpu(
         self, x: torch.Tensor, z: torch.Tensor | None = None
     ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        if (
+            not torch.compiler.is_compiling()
+            and not torch.is_grad_enabled()
+            and x.shape in ((16, 128), (24, 128))
+            and x.dtype == torch.float16
+            and x.is_contiguous()
+            and z is not None
+            and z.shape == x.shape
+            and z.dtype == x.dtype
+            and z.device == x.device
+            and z.is_contiguous()
+            and self.weight.shape == (128,)
+            and self.weight.dtype == x.dtype
+            and self.weight.device == x.device
+            and self.weight.is_contiguous()
+            and self.bias is None
+            and self.group_size is None
+            and self.norm_before_gate
+            and self.activation in ("silu", "swish")
+        ):
+            out = torch.empty_like(x)
+            torch.ops._C.rms_norm_gated_decode(out, x, z, self.weight, self.eps)
+            return out
         return self.forward_cuda(x, z)
